about_the_game:
Demonic is a classic, old-school RPG set in a seemingly peaceful world that has long forgotten its troubled past. Step into the role of Vincent, a young boy on a journey to uncover not only the truth about himself—but also the hidden history of the world around him.

Character Progression: Builds & Augments

Customize your characters by investing in the skills that suit your playstyle. Whether you specialize early or save your points for future upgrades, the choice is yours.

Enhance your gear through a flexible augment system—boost stats, mix upgrades, and forge a build that reflects your unique approach to combat and exploration.

Every Frame a Work of Art

From intense clashes to story-driven moments, the game’s world is brought to life through beautiful visuals. Detailed battlers fill every fight with energy, vibrant battle backgrounds set the tone for each encounter, expressive character faces add personality to conversations, and cutscenes unfold with stunning artwork. Every moment is designed to be as captivating to look at as it is to play.

Speed Up the Action

When you’ve figured out the perfect strategy, fast-forward lets you power through random battles without missing a beat. This feature speeds up animations and turns, so you can focus on advancing through the game without unnecessary waiting — ideal for grinding or replaying encounters with confidence. Keep the momentum going and get back to the challenges that matter most.

An Unforgettable Soundtrack

Experience a rich and immersive soundtrack that perfectly complements every battle, cutscene, and moment. The music sets the mood and draws you deeper into the world, making every experience more memorable.

A Journey Worth Taking

Dive into a 25–30 hour adventure filled with unexpected twists and turns. The story unfolds gradually, keeping you hooked with memorable characters and surprises that make every step fresh and exciting.

Minimum:

  • Processor: AMD A8-7600 / Intel® Core™ i3-2105
  • Memory: 2 MB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Microsoft Windows
  • Processor: AMD A8-7600 / Intel® Core™ i3-3225
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon™ R7 Graphics / Intel® HD Graphics 4000
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
